name: Travel Packing Checklist
description: A travel packing checklist organized by category — clothes, toiletries, tech, documents, and extras — so you pack everything you need.

items.text: Tops and t-shirts for each day or to layer
Underwear and socks for the trip length

items.note: Check the forecast before finalizing clothing

items.text: A dressier outfit if your plans need one
Sandals or a second pair of shoes
A reusable bag and a day bag
Shampoo, soap, and deodorant in travel sizes
Medicines, vitamins, and a small first-aid kit
Glasses, contacts, and solution if needed
Power bank for long days out
Camera, laptop, or tablet if needed
Cables organized in a small pouch
Passport or ID and any visas
Cash, cards, and a travel card
Copies of key documents stored separately
Neck pillow, eye mask, and earplugs
Packing cubes and a laundry bag

faq.q: How do I decide how much to pack?
faq.a: Plan outfits around your trip length and activities, then pack versatile pieces you can mix and match. Doing a small laundry mid-trip often beats hauling a heavy bag, especially for longer journeys.

faq.q: What is the difference between this and a travel checklist?
faq.a: This packing checklist lists only what goes in your bags. A travel checklist covers the whole trip — bookings, documents, money, and home prep. Use both together so planning and packing each stay focused.

faq.q: Should I pack documents and medicines in checked luggage?
faq.a: Keep passports, tickets, money, electronics, and essential medicines in your carry-on. If checked bags are delayed or lost, you still have everything you truly cannot do without.

Choose a neutral color palette so clothes coordinate, limit shoes to two or three pairs, and use packing cubes to compress and organize. Lay everything out first, then remove a few items you can manage without.
Yes. Print it or download the PDF, tick off each category as you pack, and reuse it for future trips by adjusting quantities to the destination and season.
